title: 2008 Biggin Hill Cessna Citation crash
summary: Cessna Citation VP-BGE crashed on 30 March 2008 near Farnborough while returning to Biggin Hill after reporting engine vibration shortly after takeoff. The pilot reported engine vibration and requested immediate return one minute after becoming airborne. The aircraft manoeuvred overhead and initiated descent when the crew reported a major power problem. The aircraft crashed into a house in Romsey Close after flying extremely low over a built-up area. All 5 occupants were killed.
probable_cause: The pilot reported engine vibration shortly after takeoff and decided to return to the airport. The reported vibration most likely came from a faulty air cycle machine rather than engine malfunction. Both engines were subsequently shut down either intentionally or inadvertently during the short flight. Relight attempts failed because the second engine was attempted to be relit before the first had reached sufficient speed, resulting in dual engine failure and loss of control.

factors.evidence: Pilot misidentified vibration source as engine malfunction; vibration actually came from faulty air cycle machine (p. 3)
Both engines shut down; relight attempts failed due to improper restart sequencing (p. 3)
Aircraft crashed with loss of control after both engines failed (p. 3)

events.text: Cleared for takeoff from Runway 21 at Biggin Hill; tower controller observed everything appeared normal (p. 2)
One minute after becoming airborne: 'We're making an immediate turn to return to the airport immediate turn to the airport' (p. 2)
Crew reported: 'We don't know sir we're getting engine vibration we'll come straight back' (p. 2)
Crew reported: 'We have major problem a major power problem it looks as though we're going in we're going in' (p. 2-3)
Aircraft flew extremely low over built-up area 2 nm north-northeast of Biggin Hill; witnesses reported low altitude over playing fields and houses (p. 3)
Some witnesses reported seeing nose-high attitude and banking away from houses just before impact; some reported no engine noise, others reported loud high-power engine noise (p. 3)
Left wing struck roof of house at end of Romsey Close; aircraft struck ground and caught fire, destroying attached garage. All 5 occupants fatally injured (p. 3)
